item.guhs.guhwinter_tekening.lore: Hang it on a wall: always 2x2, just like a painting. Hit it to take it down again.
item.guhs.guhwinter_tekening.leeg: A blank sheet. Nothing on it (yet), nyeg.
item.guhs.guhwinter_kerstalbum.lore: All the drawings from the Guhwinter Christmas tree. Right-click to browse.
guhwinter.tekenen.editor.titel.lootje: Drawing for the name you drew
guhwinter.tekenen.editor.uitleg: Left-click draws, right-click erases. Ctrl+Z undoes.
guhwinter.tekenen.editor.tool.pipet: Eyedropper: pick a colour from your drawing (I)
guhwinter.tekenen.editor.tool.lijn: Line: click, drag and let go (L)
guhwinter.tekenen.fout.sessie: This drawing sheet has expired. Open it again, nyeg.
guhwinter.tekenen.fout.rustig: Easy there, vads! Wait a moment and save again.
guhwinter.tekenen.fout.kapot: Something went wrong with your drawing. Try again.
guhwinter.tekenen.fout.geen_antwoord: No answer from the server. Try saving again.
guhwinter.tekenen.past_niet: Your drawing doesn't fit here: it is 2 by 2 blocks.
guhwinter.tekenen.kerstboom.dicht: The Christmas tree drawings have already been handed out. Look in your Christmas Album!
guhwinter.tekenen.kerstboom.opgehangen: Your drawing hangs in the Christmas tree! You can still change it until 25 December. Wahoog!
guhwinter.tekenen.kerstboom.bijgewerkt: Your Christmas tree drawing has been updated. Nyeg, even prettier!
guhwinter.tekenen.album.gekregen: Look in your bag: a Christmas Album with all the drawings from the Christmas tree! Right-click to browse it.
guhwinter.tekenen.album.gepakt: You got the drawing by %s to hang up. Wahoog!
guhwinter.tekenen.album.leeg: There are no drawings in the Christmas tree yet. Nyeg...
guhwinter.tekenen.album.uitleg: Take a copy to hang up: always 2x2, just like a painting. Once per drawing.
guhwinter.tekenen.album.uitleg_gepakt: You already took this one. Is it hanging somewhere yet?
